hook: 2BHK rent in Gachibowli went from *₹22,000 to ₹36,600*
tldr: Anarock data: a standard 2BHK in Gachibowli rose 66% (₹22,000 → ₹36,600) and in HITEC City 58% (₹23,000 → ₹36,350) between end-2021 and mid-2025. Office rents rose another 11.6% in a year by May 2026, a sign IT-corridor demand is still hot.

beats.what: From end-2021 to Q2 2025, standard 2BHK rents (1,000 sq ft) rose 66% in Gachibowli and 58% in HITEC City.
beats.why: Record office leasing pulls IT workers into the western corridor; office rents there rose 11.6% year-on-year (Cushman & Wakefield, May 2026).
beats.care: Before you sign: compare a few km out (Tellapur, Kokapet), negotiate the deposit, and get the rent-hike clause in writing.

cards.body: Buying isn't cheaper: flats in Madhapur sell for ₹11,000–16,000 per sq ft, and rental yield there is only 2–3%. That's why many choose to rent near work and invest elsewhere.

cards.title: how old is this data?
cards.body: The 2BHK figures are from Anarock's mid-2025 report, the latest public micro-market rent data we found. Office rents and prices are from May 2026.

cards.q: How much of your salary goes to rent?
By how much did Gachibowli 2BHK rent rise (end-2021 to mid-2025)?

viz.l: rental yield in Madhapur (renting vs buying)

learn.t: Rental yield = yearly rent ÷ property price. At 2–3%, a ₹1 crore flat earns ₹2–3 lakh a year in rent.

watch: Anarock's next rental report; whether the water crisis and new Metro lines shift demand to other areas.
